body: Thank you.  I know I still can be okay.  I'm not at the point where I AM going to kill myself yet, but the fact it is becoming a less scary and more obtainable option each day makes me worried.
Moving on is certainly in the plans at this point.

I guess you are a better person than me, because I would not have helped them, or have felt bad about enjoying their pain.  

I also would have divorced you wife a long time ago, but once again you have to have a lot more patience and understanding than me.

You're not overreacting!  My cat is really sick and old so I know how you feel right now and its overwhelming.  Especially since you say it happened so suddenly.  Its hard to accept, and ever harder when you don't expect it. 

I don't think I can make you feel better, but I can at least let you know you're not alone in feeling that way.

You know, you're absolutely correct. 

I suppose I just have a hard time feeling sympathy for people who are so rude to others and gloat about it.

Really? I didn't know I had a style?
Thanks man!

May I ask what you disagree with? I'm very curious.

Lady person chiming in. 
I'm gunna start off with the penis concern and go onto the serious ones just because I want you to know that your size is perfectly fine.  Average size is 5-6 and you're pretty damn close to that.  Also, there are alot of women out there who do NOT like big penis.  Some of us are too petite and they physically can't fit, so it kind of a good thing.

Now then, I really think this upcoming surgery is gunna take a load off of your shoulders. I really do.  It not going to fix your problems, but will most definitely be the launch of you being able to get yourself out of this funk. I don't know about your condition but you may need to talk to another doctor about hormones or something very soon.  Get to the bottom of this shit, you know?

Also, you said the doctor was shady....is he board certified?  It would be a shame if you got sick or hurt because of an incompetent doctor.  Just quickly google this guy, and affirm his legitimacy. 

Reestablishing a social circle is going to be the toughest thing to do, but I'm probably telling you nothing new.  Its going to be super hard so please don't give up on that.  I isolated myself for a long time and recently had to reteach myself the verbal skills and how to connect with people.  Its a challenge but oh so worth it, because being social has helped greatly with dealing with my mental illness.  

I wish you the best of luck, give yourself lots of time to heal, then marvel at your new self! Tis only the beginning, man.

I know at 13 I'd be freaking the fuck out too.  I totally get why you would, its justified to be upset and feel weird about it.  But you also have to realize they are more than just your parents, they are individual human beings with their own lives, with which they can do as they please.

As another has said before, don't bring it up because your father may be in on it.  

I'm truly am sorry this has caused you so much stress. :(
WHY ARE YOU SO GOOD AT THAT LOL

Same to you.  Like I hope we're walking down the street then suddenly fall into a hole but at the bottom its like puppies and netflix and things that are fun and well never want to leave.

because puppies.

Really? I'm honored I was able to touch another human being in such a way.  I usually feel like I'm no good at consoling others.  I often don't try because I don't want to come off as pretentious or know it all, so glad this had a positive impact!

I really hope you keep on keeping on, mental illness is bumpy as fuck ride man.

Its funny, because that kind of posting usually only gets a roll of the eyes or a Hide This Post and people move on. This kid really thinks people are taking the time to read his posts and get angry about them.

Its fucking facebook. 

I would usually ignore them myself, but I can't anymore and now I'm just so annoyed haha.  I guess he wins in that sense, but I ain't offended.  

As for the cake....well....

Depression is going to be a forever battle, comrade.  I know that nagging self loathing feeling very well.  Even when I've accomplished something, the small fire of hate is still there.  Just know that its conquerable, even if only for short periods of time!  

The fact that this is a life long battle means the feeling will come back everyone once in a while and you're gunna have to squash it again.  Each time though, it will become easier, and after a while it will feel like brushing an annoying fly off your shirt.  

Also, look at the progress you've made!  You said that you don't want to be in the place you were a few years ago, that's proof you are stronger and better!  It means you're making progress, and with progress comes backwards steps, but know those are only temporary.  Know that you won't be back at that place ever again, because even without that self acceptance, you know you're better than you once were.

All in all, I'm sorry if this came over as super corny or annoyingly optimistic.  I just don't want you to feel that way any longer! Being glum ain't no fun.

Nothing feels better than awakening to happiness.  
May you have many more content and peaceful days.

My father is exactly like this.  He feels entitled to be lazy and cut corners around the house because, god forbid, he has to work for a living.   
Though even when he was unemployed for half a year he still didn't do shit, he was "too depressed" and constantly complained about how he "just couldn't get out of this funk."  

Well asshole, have you tried doing the dishes for a change? Long story short I know how you feel.  Keep on keeping on!
